# DJ Zwackery

> Hardcore DJ from Melbourne, Australia, playing Happy Hardcore, UK Hardcore, and hard dance at 150+ BPM under the banner "House of Fun." Twitch Partner, streams live on Twitch, and posts a new set to YouTube most weeks.

DJ Zwackery is djzwackery.com's single-page site: bio, live status, upcoming gigs, a set archive, and a booking contact form all live on the one page, linked below by section. The live badge and embedded Twitch player update automatically, with no page reload, whenever he goes live. Structured data (schema.org MusicGroup, Event, VideoObject) is embedded in the page for machine-readable bio, gig, and video details.

## Sections

- [About](https://djzwackery.com/#about): bio, genre, location, Twitch Partner status
- [Gigs](https://djzwackery.com/#gigs): upcoming live shows with ticket links, auto-hides past dates
- [Latest sets](https://djzwackery.com/#videos): YouTube set archive embedded on-site
